# GUIDELINES.md

Recommendations for choosing among valid patterns in this repository. Binding constraints live in [RULES.md](RULES.md). Verification commands are summarized in [TESTING.md](TESTING.md) and [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md).

## E2E capability gating: `TEST_MODE`, `BROWSER_API`, and `EXTERNAL_API`

The shared Playwright suite under `realworld/specs/e2e` must run against implementations with different architectures (SPA-only, browser talking to a live API, setup that needs a reachable backend). Mode and flags are defined in [realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts). Specs import `BROWSER_API` and `EXTERNAL_API` (and derive behavior from `TEST_MODE` where applicable) and use `test.skip` or branches when a capability is not available.

| Pattern | When to use | Example in repo |
|--------|-------------|-----------------|
| **Default / UI-only** | Flows that need only forms, navigation, and DOM assertions; no live backend and no `page.route` client tests. | `realworld/specs/e2e/auth.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/health.spec.ts` (navbar and load checks). |
| **`BROWSER_API` true** | The implementation is a SPA whose HTTP client must be validated with mocked responses (`page.route`) while exercising real UI code—validation errors, auth errors, DELETE treated as success on any 2xx, malformed JSON, invalid `jwtToken` in `localStorage`. | `realworld/specs/e2e/error-handling.spec.ts`; SPA-only branches in `realworld/specs/e2e/articles.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/comments.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/auth.spec.ts`. Skill: [realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md). |
| **`EXTERNAL_API` true** | Setup and assertions need a reachable RealWorld-compatible API (`API_BASE` in `config.ts`, default `https://api.realworld.show/api` unless overridden). Use API helpers for register, articles, follow, and seed data. | `realworld/specs/e2e/navigation.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/social.spec.ts`; optional live `/tags` checks in `realworld/specs/e2e/health.spec.ts`. |

**Recommendation:** When adding E2E coverage, gate with `test.skip(!BROWSER_API, ...)` or `test.skip(!EXTERNAL_API, ...)` instead of duplicating spec files. Match existing imports from `./helpers/config` in `realworld/specs/e2e/error-handling.spec.ts`. Use selectors and routes from `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`; REST shapes and routes are summarized in [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md). For smoke and routing checks, see [realworld/skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md). For null image/bio rendering, see [realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md).

**Gap:** Full `TEST_MODE` derivation and every environment variable in `config.ts` are not excerpted in harness evidence; treat [realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts) as the source of truth when wiring a new implementation.

## Shared Playwright E2E vs local Vitest unit tests

Conformance browser tests live in the vendored tree `realworld/specs/e2e`. Angular unit tests live next to application code under `src/app` as `*.spec.ts` and run with Vitest from the repository root ([package.json](package.json)).

| Pattern | When to use | Command / workflow |
|--------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Vitest (local)** | Isolate services, interceptors, and components; fast feedback on HTTP client logic, auth, and feature services without starting the dev server or hitting a backend. | Documented in [TESTING.md](TESTING.md): `bun run test`, `bunx vitest run <path>`. Typical paths: `src/app/core/**`, `src/app/features/**/services/*.spec.ts`. See [src/AGENTS.md](src/AGENTS.md) and [src/app/core/AGENTS.md](src/app/core/AGENTS.md). |
| **Playwright (shared suite)** | Prove the SPA meets RealWorld UI and routing contracts (`realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`), including flows that need `BROWSER_API` or `EXTERNAL_API`. | `bun run test:e2e` (non-`@security`) or `bun run test:e2e:security` per [package.json](package.json). Single-file iteration: [skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md](skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md). |

**Recommendation:** After changing logic in `src/`, run Vitest first, then run Playwright when routes, selectors, or error rendering change. Do not add duplicate conformance scenarios under `src/app` when the shared spec in `realworld/specs/e2e` already covers the behavior—extend the shared spec with the gating patterns above. Application structure and ownership are in [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md); the component index is in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

**Gap:** CI in supplied evidence runs Playwright and build; Vitest is documented locally but may not gate every pipeline (see [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

## When to use `realworld/` skills vs `src/` feature work

| Goal | Where to work | Skill or entry |
|------|----------------|----------------|
| **Conformance E2E** — auth, articles, health, null fields, invalid token | `realworld/specs/e2e/*.spec.ts` and helpers | [realworld/skills/add-e2e-auth-flow-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-auth-flow-spec/SKILL.md), [realworld/skills/add-e2e-article-crud-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-article-crud-spec/SKILL.md), [realworld/skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md), [realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md), [realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md). Layout: [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md). |
| **Product implementation** — Angular routes, components, services, interceptors | `src/app/features/*`, `src/app/core/*`, `src/app/shared/*` | [src/app/features/AGENTS.md](src/app/features/AGENTS.md) for routes aligned with E2E (`/editor`, `/article/{slug}`, `/profile`, `/settings`). Unit tests co-located as `*.spec.ts`. |
| **Contract alignment** — URLs, form names, CSS classes, `jwtToken` | Implementation must match shared contract; change specs only when the contract intentionally evolves | [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md); UI detail in `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`. |

**Recommendation:** Implement behavior in `src/` first. Add or extend Playwright coverage in `realworld/specs/e2e` when the behavior is part of RealWorld conformance or is already exercised by inventory specs (auth, articles, navigation, social). Prefer Vitest for pure TypeScript and HTTP client logic in [src/app/core/AGENTS.md](src/app/core/AGENTS.md). Do not fork selector strings in `src/` that diverge from `SELECTORS.md` without updating the contract and E2E together.

## Angular feature layout under `src/app`

The Conduit SPA organizes routes and feature code by domain area. Local conventions for agents are in [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md).

| Pattern | When to use | Where it lives |
|--------|-------------|----------------|
| **Feature modules / folders** | User-facing flows: article list and editor, profile and favorites, account settings. | `src/app/features/` (article, profile, settings per [src/app/features/AGENTS.md](src/app/features/AGENTS.md)). |
| **Core** | Auth, JWT storage, HTTP interceptors, and app-wide services shared across features. | `src/app/core/` ([src/app/core/AGENTS.md](src/app/core/AGENTS.md)). |
| **Routing** | URL shapes required by shared E2E specs (`/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/editor`, `/article/:slug`, `/profile/:username`, etc.). | `src/app/app.routes.ts` (routes in [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md) and `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`). |

**Recommendation:** Add new Conduit screens inside the matching `src/app/features/*` folder with co-located `*.spec.ts` for Vitest. Keep selector classes and routes aligned with the frontend contract so Playwright specs pass without forked copies. For architecture and data flow across `src/` and `realworld/`, see [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Playwright: full E2E vs `@security` only

Two root scripts split the same `realworld/specs/e2e` tree by grep tag ([package.json](package.json)).

| Pattern | When to use | Command / workflow |
|--------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Non-security suite** | Day-to-day conformance: auth, articles, comments, navigation, settings, error handling, null fields. | `bun run test:e2e` (`playwright test --grep-invert @security`). |
| **Security-tagged specs only** | Tests marked `@security` (for example `realworld/specs/e2e/xss-security.spec.ts` in inventory). | `bun run test:e2e:security`. |

**Recommendation:** Do not run the full suite when you only change security-sensitive rendering; use `test:e2e:security`. After broad SPA or routing changes, run `test:e2e` first. For one spec file, use [skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md](skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md). Root Playwright config extends `realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts` (inferred from analysis and [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)).

## API contract verification: Bruno vs Hurl

Both runners target the same OpenAPI contract under `realworld/specs/api` ([CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md)). Hurl files are the maintained source; Bruno collections under `realworld/specs/api/bruno` are generated and checked in CI in the realworld tree (inferred from analysis).

| Pattern | When to use | Entry point |
|--------|-------------|-------------|
| **Bruno** | Manual exploration, folder-by-folder runs; default host `http://localhost:8000` via `HOST`. | `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-bruno.sh`. Details: [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md). |
| **Hurl** | Scripted CI, sequential runs with shared `uid` for auth isolation; explicit `host` and `uid` variables. | `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh`. |

**Recommendation:** Prefer Hurl when adding or changing API scenarios so `hurl-to-bruno.js` can regenerate Bruno and CI can fail on drift. Prefer Bruno for interactive debugging against a local backend. Neither runner replaces Playwright; use [TESTING.md](TESTING.md) for layered verification (Vitest → E2E → API).

**Gap:** Root CI may not invoke these shell scripts directly; confirm backend host and env in `realworld/specs/api/README.md` before changing defaults (file not excerpted).

## Format on commit: Prettier and lint-staged

| Pattern | When to use | Evidence |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| **Pre-commit via Husky + lint-staged** | Keep staged TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JSON, and Markdown consistent without relying on CI alone. | Active hook `husky-pre-commit` runs `npx lint-staged` ([HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md), `.husky/pre-commit`). |
| **Manual / CI format check** | Verify the whole tree before push or when not committing (for example agent edits). | `bun run format:check` from [package.json](package.json); proposed hooks in [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md) reference the same command. |

**Recommendation:** Rely on the active pre-commit hook for day-to-day edits. After large refactors or harness-only changes, run `bun run format:check` locally. Exact `lint-staged` glob rules are not in supplied evidence (coverage gap); if pre-commit fails unexpectedly, inspect lint-staged config in the repo root when present.

**Contrast with binding rules:** Prettier does not replace tests. [RULES.md](RULES.md) and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) still expect Vitest and Playwright verification for application changes.
